edition: KHIII + Re Mind, English IDs with explicitly identified Japanese screenshot aliases
fragmentMethod: All 90 Game8 screenshots fetched HTTP 200 and individually inspected in nine five-pair contact sheets. Retain image URLs as evidence, not as substitutes for written locations. Rotated map views have no reliable numeric world coordinates. Starlight/Misty direction words preserve the cited guide map orientation. Greek δ/ε/ζ correspond to the Japanese guide IV/V/VI sphere sequence; α/γ correspond to 1/3. All 40 GameFAQs close-up image links and 3 overview images failed web retrieval; Game8 provided a distinct accessible source. Direct GameFAQs image 202 also 403. Indexed TA retrieval returned full relevant Eclipse route paragraphs after direct/full-page open failed; STR-13 glyph was unusable.

buildReferences.appendInstructions: At Gummi level 99, the base custom-ship cost limit is 1,000. This endpoint does not establish the cost or AP limit at every intervening level.

buildReferences.name: Teeny ship block sharing
buildReferences.summary: A block can be reused across the main ship and a Teeny design.
buildReferences.instructions: The cited KHIII building guide reports that owning one block permits it in the main ship and in a Teeny design used twice, for three equipped instances. Fit Teeny ships for supplementary firepower; this is source-reported behavior, not a newly executed Steam test.

schwarzgeistReplay.appendInstructions: A-rank replay option, after an initial Schwarzgeist victory: equip the rewarded Golden Highwind, Golden Falcon and Golden Invincible Teeny ships, and Repair Kit. Community players report success by destroying the missile pods, then repeatedly destroying regenerating shields while avoiding the main body; finish once the score reaches 1,000,000. Keep moving/rolling through attacks and heal with Repair Kit. This is a reported replay strategy, not a claim of an optimal or universally guaranteed loadout. Golden Highwind requires the prior clear, so use the starter guidance for the first victory.
